description: This file defines classes and functions related to Chrome's trust store, including data structures for storing root certificates, methods for creating and managing trust store instances, and functions to access Chrome root store version and anchors.

classes.name: ChromeRootStoreData
classes.description: Container class that stores Chrome Root Store data, including root certificates and version.

classes.name: TrustStoreChrome
classes.description: Represents Chrome's trust store, either using the default or custom root certificates.

classes.name: ChromeRootCertInfo
classes.description: Structure holding DER-encoded root certificate data.

methods.name: CreateChromeRootStoreData
methods.description: Static method to create ChromeRootStoreData from a proto, returns nullopt if errors occur.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes trust store with the default Chrome Root Store.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome(const ChromeRootStoreData& anchors)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes trust store with specified anchors.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is in the trust store.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Chrome Root Store.
